_comment: Firebase Hosting in front of the Cloud Run service. Hosting serves the
built SPA from its CDN and rewrites /api/** to the container, so the
browser talks to one origin and apiBase() resolving to same-origin is
correct with no CORS involved and no backend URL baked into the bundle.
KNOWN LIMIT: a Hosting rewrite to Cloud Run times out at 60 seconds.
GET /api/v1/desk36/dmi is allowed 120s by the client because a cold scan
of a full watchlist makes one timesales call per symbol. A warm board is
far under 60s, but a cold one can exceed it and will surface as a 504 on
the DI readings only. If that bites, open the Cloud Run URL directly -
the container serves the same SPA itself and has no such ceiling.
serviceId/region must match what deploy/cloudrun.sh created.
